changeBinancePool(address).details: only owner can change binance pool address

deposit().details: deposits the given amount of underlying tokens into ceros

depositAll().details: deposits all the available underlying tokens into ceros

harvest().details: claims yeild from ceros in aBNBc and transfers to feeRecipient

initialize(address,address,address,addre.details: initialize function - Constructor for Upgradable contract, can be only called once during deployment

params.destination: Address of the ceros router contract

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

panic().details: withdraws everything from ceros and transfers to masterVault

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

withdraw(address,uint256).details: withdraws the given amount of underlying tokens from ceros and transfers to masterVault
